label: Copy 1 — atual aprovada
scope: complete current HTML copy, responsive heading configuration, metadata/JSON-LD and asset descriptions; no rewrite or automatic client-site assembly

rules.responsiveVariants: Same V1; full/short/compact variants are not separate copy versions
rules.cta: Exactly one rendered line at every tested viewport; never truncate or shrink font to fit
rules.unconfirmedData: Stop; do not invent, inherit demo values or remove sections automatically
rules.changedPolicy: Review required; factual input is not permission to invent wording/promises
rules.clientActivation: Filled export is review-only. Demo UI/guards, rating/reviews, Google invitation and live destinations need instance-specific approved adaptation before use
rules.knownGoogleStep: Current source says Clique no botão amarelo. When applying the approved color process, use its already approved instruction Clique em Avaliar no Google; no automatic color-name inference
rules.ownership: Image/OG-image references are managed by assets.json and build-assets.py; body copy is not an asset output
rules.analysisPanel: Technical diagnostic panel strings are not sales copy; some include demo geography and require explicit adaptation if a real instance keeps the panel
rules.heroBenefits: Select exactly four confirmed benefit IDs from copy/hero-benefits.json. No automatic geography/audience/urgency substitution.
